# AI Text Cleaner

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.6.1-blue.svg)

**An [OpenClaw](https://openclaw.ai) skill and standalone Python utility for sanitizing Markdown generated by LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.).**

Copy-pasting text from AI chatbots often results in a mess of formatting errors: broken tables, weird encoding characters (`â€™`), "hallucinated" artifacts, and disjointed lists. This tool instantly cleans up that mess, turning raw AI output into professional, publish-ready Markdown.

## What's New in v1.6.1

- **Bug fix:** Removed a stray backslash line continuation on the `isupper()` check in Phase 4 that caused an `IndentationError` on Python 3.12.

## What's New in v1.6

- **Targeted Perplexity link removal:** Only Markdown links whose URL belongs to a Perplexity domain (`perplexity.ai` or `ppl-ai-*` S3 upload URLs) are removed. All other Markdown links — including numbered and bulleted reference lists — are kept intact.

## What's New in v1.5

- **Python 3.12 smart-quote fix:** Replaced raw-string `\u` escapes in `re.sub` replacement arguments with named variables and lambda closures, avoiding the `re.error: bad escape \u` crash introduced in Python 3.12.

## What's New in v1.4

- **Smarter Perplexity inline link handling (superseded by v1.6):** Introduced line-by-line processing to preserve standalone reference list items.

## What's New in v1.3

- **Perplexity footnote removal:** Strips inline footnote references such as `[^1]`, `[^12]`, and sequences like `[^1][^2][^3]`.
- **Perplexity inline link removal:** Strips `[link text](url)` constructs that Perplexity inserts as source citations.

## What's New in v1.2

- **Strict table detection:** Distinguishes real Markdown tables from list items containing pipes.
- **Smart title protection:** Prevents documents starting with bullet points from having their structure flattened.
- **Enhanced citation cleaning:** Correctly removes `[cite_start]` and `[source:...]` tags.
- **Safety gaps:** Tables are always followed by a blank line to prevent text merging.

---

## Why do I need this?

If you frequently copy text from AI tools into documents or CMSs, you likely face these issues:

- **Broken tables:** AI often splits table rows across multiple lines or inserts garbage columns (`||`).
- **Encoding glitches:** Smart quotes turn into garbage like `â€™` or `â€œ` when moving between operating systems.
- **AI cruft:** Phrases like "Artifact 1:", "Here is the table:", or `[cite]` tags clutter your text.
- **Formatting inconsistencies:** Headers that are just bold text (`**Title**`), mixed bullet styles (`•`, `*`, `-`), and excessive blank lines.
- **Perplexity citations:** Footnote markers like `[^1]` and Perplexity-domain source links are removed, while all legitimate Markdown links (reference lists, external URLs) are preserved.

This script fixes all of these instantly.

## Installation

### As an OpenClaw skill

Install directly into your OpenClaw workspace:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/redasadki/ai-text-cleaner.git ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/ai-text-cleaner
```

The skill will auto-trigger when processing AI-generated Markdown. Pairs with the [deslop](https://github.com/stephenturner/skill-deslop) skill: run `clean_ai.py` first for mechanical cleanup, then apply deslop rules for editorial quality.

### Standalone

```bash
git clone https://github.com/redasadki/ai-text-cleaner.git
cd ai-text-cleaner
```

**Requirements:** Python 3.8 or later (standard library only, no external dependencies).

## Usage

### Clean a file

```bash
python3 scripts/clean_ai.py input.md > output.md
```

### Clean from clipboard (macOS)

Copy text from the AI, run this command, then paste the clean result.

```bash
pbpaste | python3 scripts/clean_ai.py | pbcopy
```

### Shell alias

Add to your `~/.zshrc` for a quick `cleanai` command:

```bash
alias cleanai='pbpaste | python3 /path/to/ai-text-cleaner/scripts/clean_ai.py | pbcopy && echo "✨ Clipboard cleaned!"'
```

### System-wide keyboard shortcut (macOS)

1. Open the **Shortcuts** app.
2. Create a new shortcut with a **Run Shell Script** action:
   ```bash
   export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
   pbpaste | /usr/bin/python3 /path/to/ai-text-cleaner/scripts/clean_ai.py | pbcopy
   ```
3. Assign a keyboard shortcut (e.g., `Cmd+Option+Shift+V`).

---

## Features

### Table repair

- Merges rows split across multiple lines.
- Detects true column count via separator lines and bold-text rhythm.
- Strips empty ghost columns (`||`).
- Keeps non-table text out of table structures.

### Deep cleaning

- Fixes UTF-8 mojibake (`â€™` → `'`, `Ã©` → `é`).
- Removes AI meta-text: `[cite_start]`, `[source:...]`, `Artifact 1:`, citation numbers `[1][2]`.
- Removes Perplexity footnote references: `[^1]`, `[^1][^2]`, etc.
- Removes Perplexity-domain links only: URLs on `perplexity.ai` or `ppl-ai-*` S3 buckets.
- Preserves all other Markdown links, including numbered and bulleted reference lists.
- Strips decorative separators (`***`, `---`) while preserving table separators.
- Standardizes quotes, dashes, and punctuation spacing.

### Structural formatting

- Splits dense text blocks at sentence boundaries.
- Converts standalone `**Bold Lines**` to `## Headers`.
- Promotes heading hierarchy (H1 → plain title, H2 → H1).
- Standardizes all bullet types to dashes (`-`).
- Merges broken headers and list items.

---

## Regex pattern reference

| Target | Pattern | Result | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Citations | `\[cite_start\]\|\[(?:cite\|source):\s*[^\]]+\]` | *(removed)* | Strip `[cite_start]`, `[source:...]` |
| Artifact labels | `\b(?:Artifact\|Screen\|Section)\s+\d+\s*:\s*` | *(removed)* | Strip "Artifact 1:" labels |
| Citation numbers | `(\[\d+\])+` | *(removed)* | Strip `[1]`, `[1][2]` |
| Perplexity footnotes | `(\[\^\d+\][ \t]*)+` | *(removed)* | Strip `[^1]`, `[^1][^2][^3]` |
| Perplexity links | `\[.*?\]\(https?://[^)]*(?:perplexity\.ai\|ppl-ai-)[^)]*\)` | *(removed)* | Strip Perplexity-domain links only |
| Smart quotes (open) | `(^\|[\s\(\[{])"` | `\1\u201c` | Straight → curly opening quotes |
| Smart quotes (close) | `"` | `\u201d` | Remaining → curly closing quotes |
| Apostrophes | `(\w)'(\w)` | `\1\u2019\2` | Fix mid-word apostrophes |
| Semicolons | `;\s*([a-z])` | `. \U\1` | Split sentences at semicolons |
| Em dashes | `\u2014` | ` \u2013 ` | Em-dash → spaced en-dash |
| Separators | `***` / `^---+$` | *(removed)* | Strip decorative lines |
| Bullets | `^[ \t]*[*\u2022]\s+` | `- ` | Standardize to dashes |
| Bold headers | `^\s*\*\*([^*]+)\*\*\s*$` | `## \1` | Bold-only lines → H2 |
| Header colons | `^(#{1,6}\s+.+?):\s*$` | `\1` | Remove trailing colons |
